Docs.summary: Registers an async validation task for a specific field. The task is tracked for pending/faulted state queries via and . If a task is already tracked for this field, the previously registered is cancelled and the new task replaces it. The takes ownership of the supplied : it will be cancelled if a subsequent validation supersedes this one, and disposed once completes.
Docs.remarks:
If is already completed, it is settled synchronously: the field is not parked in the pending state, a faulted task is surfaced via , and is disposed.
Validators backing are expected to clear any prior validation messages for the field up-front (before awaiting), and to avoid writing partial results to a on a path that may subsequently throw. If a validator does write partial state and then throws, those messages remain in the store until cleared by a subsequent successful validation.

Docs.param: A token that signals cancellation of this validation pass. The token is exposed to async handlers via . If the caller cancels the token, this method throws ; the form is not marked as faulted in that case and the previous form-level fault state is preserved. The token bounds the in-flight pass only; field-level validation tasks that start independently during the awaited window (for example, from user edits) are not linked to this token and continue running.
Docs.summary: Validates this asynchronously. Cancels any pending field-level async validation tasks, invokes the synchronous handlers, then invokes and awaits the asynchronous handlers concurrently. Exceptions from synchronous handlers propagate to the caller, matching . Any non-cancellation exception thrown by an asynchronous handler is contained: the form is marked as faulted (observable via the parameterless ) and the method returns false. While the asynchronous portion is in flight, the parameterless returns true so applications can show a global "validating..." indicator without wrapping the call themselves. The form-level result is updated only when a pass completes; it is preserved across caller-cancelled passes.
Docs.returns: True if there are no validation messages after validation and no async handler faulted; otherwise false.
Docs.remarks: Validation must not be re-entered. Do not call or from inside an , , or handler attached to the same ; doing so produces undefined behavior.
Docs.exception: Thrown when is cancelled before or during the validation pass.
